value.rationale: At a nonsmooth fold the frozen right branch loses its isolated fixed point as its slope reaches unity. The joint sweep/multiplier limit is therefore an intrinsic, motivated threshold regime, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The result quantifies the transition from known hyperbolic logarithmic tipping delay to algebraic neutral delay through an explicit monotone crossover function and the stronger logarithmic normalization; this precise fact informs first-passage interpretation near weakly unstable border equilibria, with only an affine-scalar validity claim.
